transcript_tail.text: Now the Codex→Claude delegation (dry-run) and a claude→codex status check on a real path:

All `work move` paths work: Codex→Claude delegates to the importer (dry-run), Claude→Codex reports app-import status correctly. Let me update the README and epic, then commit. First the README section:
3 of 4 slices done and committed. Let me mark the task done and update the epic checklist for migrate.

Three of the four epic slices are now delivered, committed, and reflected on the board:

| Slice | Command | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| Inventory | `work` / `work ls` | `972a872` |
| Stale-detect | `work stale` | `1344627` |
| Migrate | `work move` | `9b66152` |

**242 tests green** (37 new across the three). Epic **#13** checklist shows 3/4 boxes checked; **trigger** is the only remaining item.

A quick note on `work move`'s honesty: Codex→Claude actually converts (dry-run, `--write` to commit); Claude→Codex can't be automated (Codex's "import external agent session" is app-only), so that direction reports import status instead of pretending to perform the move.

The last slice, **trigger**, is the outward-facing one — it spawns real agent work. You earlier picked migrate over it and flagged a dry-run default. Codex (`codex exec`) is clean; the Claude side would be local headless `claude -p` (no cloud-create API exists).
